description: This is a Kotlin source file implementing the ForYouScreen composable for a Jetpack Compose Android application. It defines the UI for the 'For You' feature, including onboarding, news feed, scrollbars, and deep link handling.

methods.name: ForYouScreen
methods.description: Main composable function rendering the 'For You' screen, including onboarding, news feed, loading overlay, and scrollbars.

methods.name: ForYouScreen
methods.description: Internal overloaded version that takes UI states and callbacks to build the screen's UI.

methods.name: onboarding
methods.description: Defines onboarding UI component within the lazy staggered grid based on the onboarding UI state.

methods.name: TopicSelection
methods.description: Displays a horizontally scrolling grid of topic buttons for user selection during onboarding.

methods.name: SingleTopicButton
methods.description: Represents individual topic button with icon and toggle state.

methods.name: TopicIcon
methods.description: Displays an asynchronously loaded image icon for a topic.

methods.name: NotificationPermissionEffect
methods.description: Requests notification permission on supported Android versions.

methods.name: DeepLinkEffect
methods.description: Handles deep linking to news resources by opening URLs in a custom Chrome tab.

methods.name: feedItemsSize
methods.description: Calculates total number of feed items including onboarding item, used for scroll bar sizing.

methods.name: ForYouScreenPopulatedFeed
methods.description: Previews the ForYouScreen with a populated feed for testing UI in different states.

methods.name: ForYouScreenOfflinePopulatedFeed
methods.description: Previews the screen with a filled feed but offline state.

methods.name: ForYouScreenTopicSelection
methods.description: Previews the screen with topic selection onboarding UI for testing.

methods.name: ForYouScreenLoading
methods.description: Previews the loading state of the ForYouScreen.

methods.name: ForYouScreenPopulatedAndLoading
methods.description: Previews combined loading and populated feed for testing UI during loading.
